
		<div class="postcontent">
			    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        欧拉函数
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>本文是对<a href="https://blog.csdn.net/Wxb314/article/details/148166969" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">这篇文章</a>的补充说明，补充了一些结论4的一些细节</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\varphi(n)\)</span> 表示的是小于等于 $ 𝑛 $ 和 $ 𝑛 $ 互质的数的个数</p>
<h1 id="结论1">结论1</h1>
<p><span class="math inline">\(p\)</span> 为质数，则 <span class="math inline">\(\varphi(p) = p - 1\)</span></p>
<h1 id="结论2">结论2</h1>
<p><span class="math inline">\(p\)</span> 为质数，则 <span class="math inline">\(\varphi(p^k) = p^k-p^{k-1} = (p-1) \times p^{k-1}\)</span><br>
证明：<br>
<span class="math inline">\(\because 1\)</span> 到 <span class="math inline">\(p^k\)</span> 中共有 <span class="math inline">\(p^{k-1}\)</span> 个数是 <span class="math inline">\(p\)</span> 的倍数<br>
$\therefore $ 与 <span class="math inline">\(p^k\)</span> 互质的数有 <span class="math inline">\(p^k-p^{k-1}\)</span> 个</p>
<h1 id="结论3">结论3</h1>
<p><span class="math inline">\(p,q\)</span> 为互异质数，则 <span class="math inline">\(\varphi(pq) = \varphi(p) \times \varphi(q)\)</span><br>
证明:<br>
<span class="math inline">\(\varphi(p) = p - 1, \varphi(q) = q - 1\)</span><br>
<span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 到 <span class="math inline">\(pq\)</span> 中有 <span class="math inline">\(q\)</span> 个 <span class="math inline">\(p\)</span> 的倍数， <span class="math inline">\(p\)</span> 个 <span class="math inline">\(q\)</span> 的倍数，其中 <span class="math inline">\(pq\)</span> 算了两次<br>
<span class="math inline">\(\therefore \varphi (pq) = pq-p-q+1=(p-1)(q-1)=\varphi (p) \times \varphi (q)\)</span></p>
<h1 id="结论4">结论4</h1>
<p><span class="math inline">\(p,q\)</span> 为互异质数，则 <span class="math inline">\(\varphi(p^a  q^b) = \varphi(p^a) \times \varphi(q^b)\)</span><br>
证明：<br>
<span class="math inline">\(\varphi(p^a) = (p-1) \times p^{a-1} , \varphi(q^b) = (q-1) \times q^{b-1}\)</span><br>
<span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 到 <span class="math inline">\(p^a q^b\)</span> 中有 <span class="math inline">\(p^{a-1} q^b\)</span> 个 <span class="math inline">\(p\)</span> 的倍数， <span class="math inline">\(p^a q^{b-1}\)</span> 个 <span class="math inline">\(q\)</span> 的倍数， <span class="math inline">\(p^{a-1} q^{b-1}\)</span> 个 <span class="math inline">\(pq\)</span> 的倍数</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 到 <span class="math inline">\(p^a q^b\)</span> 中与 <span class="math inline">\(p^aq^b\)</span> 不互质的数有 <span class="math inline">\(p^{a-1} q^b+p^a q^{b-1}-p^{a-1} q^{b-1}\)</span> 个</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\begin{align*}
\varphi(p^a  q^b) &amp;= p^aq^b-p^{a-1} q^b-p^a q^{b-1}+p^{a-1} q^{b-1} \\
                  &amp;= (pq-q-p+1)p^{a-1} q^{b-1} \\
                  &amp;= (p-1)p^{a-1}(q-1)q^{b-1} \\
                  &amp;= \varphi(p^a) \times \varphi(q^b)
\end{align*}\)</span></p>
<h1 id="结论45">结论4.5</h1>
<p>推广： <span class="math inline">\(\varphi({\textstyle \prod_{i=1}^{n}} p_i^{a_i})= {\textstyle \prod_{i=1}^{n}}\varphi( p_i^{a_i})\)</span><br>
证明：<br>
考虑数学归纳法<br>
假设第 <span class="math inline">\(n\)</span> 项成立，设 <span class="math inline">\(m={\textstyle \prod_{i=1}^{m+1}}p_i^{a_i},A={\textstyle \prod_{i=1}^{m}}p_i^{a_i},B=p_{n+1}^{a_{n+1}}\)</span></p>
<h5 id="1--到--中与--不互质的数有--个">（1） <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 到 <span class="math inline">\(m\)</span> 中与 <span class="math inline">\(A\)</span> 不互质的数有 <span class="math inline">\((A - \varphi (A)) \times B\)</span> 个</h5>
<p>解释：<br>
设 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 到 <span class="math inline">\(m\)</span> 中与 <span class="math inline">\(A\)</span> 不互质的数为 <span class="math inline">\(b\)</span><br>
设 <span class="math inline">\(b = kA+a,0\le k\le B-1,1\le a \le A\)</span><br>
（注意，这里对 <span class="math inline">\(b\)</span> 的分解不同于普通的 <span class="math inline">\(\bmod A\)</span> ，但仍然保持一一对应的关系）<br>
<span class="math inline">\(gcd(b,A) = gcd(kA+a,A) = gcd(a,A)\)</span><br>
$\therefore $ 要使 <span class="math inline">\(b\)</span> 与 <span class="math inline">\(A\)</span> 不互质，充要条件是 <span class="math inline">\(a\)</span> 与 <span class="math inline">\(A\)</span> 不互质，而与 <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 无关<br>
<span class="math inline">\(a\)</span> 有 <span class="math inline">\((A - \varphi (A))\)</span> 个取值， <span class="math inline">\(k\)</span> 有 <span class="math inline">\(B\)</span> 个取值<br>
$\therefore b $ 有 <span class="math inline">\((A - \varphi (A)) \times B\)</span> 个取值</p>
<h5 id="2---到--中与--不互质的数有--个">（2）  <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 到 <span class="math inline">\(m\)</span> 中与 <span class="math inline">\(B\)</span> 不互质的数有 <span class="math inline">\((B - \varphi (B)) \times A\)</span> 个</h5>
<p>同理可得</p>
<h5 id="3---到--中与--不互质与--不互质的数有--个">（3）  <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 到 <span class="math inline">\(m\)</span> 中与 <span class="math inline">\(A\)</span> 不互质、与 <span class="math inline">\(B\)</span> 不互质的数有 <span class="math inline">\((A - \varphi (A)) \times (B - \varphi (B))\)</span> 个</h5>
<hr>
<p>引理：在模 <span class="math inline">\(p_{n+1}\)</span> 时， <span class="math inline">\(yA(0 \le y \le p_{n+1}-1)\)</span> 互不相等<br>
考虑反证<br>
假设 <span class="math inline">\(\exists y_1,y_2\in [0,p_{n+1}-1],y_1\ne y_2,\)</span><br>
$y_1A \equiv y_2A \pmod{p_{n+1}} $<br>
则 <span class="math inline">\((y_1-y_2)A \equiv 0 \pmod{p_{n+1}}\)</span><br>
<span class="math inline">\(\because gcd(A,p_{n+1})=1\)</span><br>
<span class="math inline">\(\therefore y_1-y_2\equiv 0 \pmod{p_{n+1}}\)</span><br>
矛盾<br>
此事在费马小定理中亦有记载</p>
<hr>
<p>依旧设 <span class="math inline">\(1\)</span> 到 <span class="math inline">\(m\)</span> 中与 <span class="math inline">\(A\)</span> 不互质的数为 <span class="math inline">\(b\)</span><br>
依旧设 <span class="math inline">\(b = kA+a,0\le k\le B-1,1\le a \le A\)</span><br>
设 <span class="math inline">\(k=xp_{n+1}+y,0\le x\le p_{n+1}^{a_{n+1}-1}-1,0\le y\le p_{n+1}-1\)</span><br>
<span class="math inline">\(b=(xp_{n+1}+y)A+a=Axp_{n+1}+yA+a\)</span><br>
要使 <span class="math inline">\(b\)</span> 与 <span class="math inline">\(A\)</span> 不互质， <span class="math inline">\(a\)</span> 有 <span class="math inline">\(A-\varphi(A)\)</span> 个取值<br>
要使 <span class="math inline">\(b\)</span> 与 <span class="math inline">\(B\)</span> 不互质，即 <span class="math inline">\(b\)</span> 是 <span class="math inline">\(p_{n+1}\)</span> 的倍数，<br>
由引理得，对于任意的 <span class="math inline">\(a\)</span> 与 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span>，有且仅有 1 个 <span class="math inline">\(y\)</span> 使 <span class="math inline">\(b\)</span> 是 <span class="math inline">\(p_{n+1}\)</span> 的倍数。<br>
<span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 有 <span class="math inline">\(p_{n+1}^{a_{n+1}-1}\)</span> 种取值，<span class="math inline">\(a\)</span> 有 <span class="math inline">\(A-\varphi(A)\)</span> 种取值，<span class="math inline">\(y\)</span> 在 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 与 <span class="math inline">\(a\)</span> 确定时只有一种取值<br>
故共有 <span class="math inline">\(p_{n+1}^{a_{n+1}-1} \times (A-\varphi(A)) = (A - \varphi (A)) \times (B - \varphi (B))\)</span> 种取值</p>
<hr>
<p>综上， <span class="math inline">\(\varphi(m)=\varphi(AB)=AB-(A - \varphi (A)) \times B-(B - \varphi (B)) \times A+(A - \varphi (A)) \times (B - \varphi (B))=\varphi(A)\varphi(B)\)</span></p>
<h1 id="总结">总结</h1>
<p>对于结论3、结论4、结论4.5的证明都用到了以下结构：<br>
<span class="math inline">\(\varphi (xy)=xy- 与 x 不互质的数的个数 - 与 y 不互质的数的个数 + 与 x , y 都不互质的数的个数\)</span><br>
这是容斥思想的体现</p>

</div>
